verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a card & expense management API surface ("virtual cards", budgets, users, transactions) and webhook notifications, implying some programmatic card management, but there is no explicit documentation of endpoints for creating a card with a limit, locking a card, or updating card controls. missing for 10: explicit API reference/endpoints for card creation with limits, card lock/unlock actions, control updates, and any hands-on or independent confirmation these operations work as described.
